data.title: Ahold Delhaize & Uber Eats Expand Partnership: Upside Ahead?
data.body: UBER expands Uber Eats grocery delivery with Ahold Delhaize USA, adding nearly 2,000 Northeast/Mid-Atlantic stores, promos, Uber One perks and SNAP/EBT.
